title: Patch: Jungle Loser always attacks
notes: C+ #19.2 Jungle Loser's end-of-turn attack is no longer a 100% chance: it always attacks a random enemy Unit; its chance param and its rng draw are removed, the old script is kept for replays through v0.5.12ap.

player.title: Jungle Loser always attacks
text: Jungle Loser's end-of-turn attack no longer says "100% chance"; it always attacks.
